name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Fresh Strawberry Banana Yogurt Smoothie
whyItWorks: Real pureed bananas and strawberries blended with plain yogurt and honey. Hydrating and potassium-rich for afternoon work sessions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Strawberry Banana Smoothie; request oat milk or almond milk if dairy-sensitive.
watchOuts: Contains pureed strawberries with fine seeds; order plain banana vanilla if avoiding seeds completely
